All tests pass. 

## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a **tampered Python standard library file** (`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/pty.py`). 

Someone had injected a malicious line into the `fork()` function:
```python
raise OSError(errno.EAGAIN, "Resource temporarily unavailable")
```

This line caused every call to `pty.fork()` to immediately fail with a `BlockingIOError`, which is why all process spawning operations were failing.

The fix was to restore the original, unmodified version of `pty.py` that properly implements the `fork()` function using `os.forkpty()` or falling back to `os.fork()` with a PTY pair.

All 12 tests now pass (with 2 skipped for unrelated reasons).
